title: Bloodstone

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Bloodstone is a material used to craft the "Blood" version of some Ashlands weapons. They have a chance to be found in the Charred chests inside Charred Fortresses located in Ashlands.
A weapon upgraded with Bloodstone has its damage increased by 0.2% for every HP the player is missing. It is not HP the target is missing.

sections.text: There is a creature (internal ID "Goblin_Gem") that never appears in the actual game, but can be spawned using the console, that drops all three kinds of Ashlands gemstones.
